newsitem.title: UK: LASMO eases as NatWest turns more cautious. [CORRECTED 11:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: LASMO eases as NatWest turns more cautious. [CORRECTED 11:45 GMT]

text.p: Shares in LASMO Plc eased 2-1/2p to 671p on Friday after NatWest turned more cautious on oil exploration and production stocks and against a background of weaker crude oil prices, dealers said.

NatWest published a research note changing its recommendation on LASMO to "hold" (corrects from "reduce" to "hold") from "add" and on Cairn Energy Plc to "hold" from "add". Cairn shares shed 1p to 582p.
NatWest said it maintained its "hold" recommendation on Enterprise Oil Plc, up 3p at 618-1/2p.

"Certain stocks have not yet discounted the short-term weakness in oil prices that we have forecast for the second quarter," the note said. Oil prices have fallen 30 percent since the beginning of the year.
NatWest said it remains positive on the long-term outlook for oil and gas prices and retains its $20 a barrel forecast for the year as a whole.
